about: Renders a single-line text field. Name it with a label, with `aria-label`, or by composing it into `Field`.

size.about: Every size in every look. The sizes read the control scale, so an input and a button of the same size are the same height.
size.title: Sizes and looks

states.about: Rest, keyboard focus, disabled, read-only and invalid in every look. The subtle and flushed looks report focus by widening their edge to 2px in the ring color. A read-only field dashes its edges. The invalid state reads `aria-invalid`, the attribute a screen reader also reads.
states.title: States

status.about: Every status in every look. A status sets the edge and the focus ring from its palette.
status.title: Statuses

title: Input
